about.sectionTitle: From the edges of technology into systems that carry real weight.
paragraphs: I started from the edges of technology, between urban memory, village roots, warnets, second-hand PCs, failed early attempts, and a long self-taught path. That path eventually led me into banking-grade systems, finance-domain services, and architecture work spanning web, backend, mobile, and infrastructure.

Today I ship whatever layer the product needs: React/Next.js, Golang services, Android at the depth the job requires. The pace comes from a local operator stack I actually run: model routing, computer-use on macOS, MCP hosts, persistent context across sessions and machines.
Full-stack stays. The agent layer is how I move faster — it does not replace the stack. I am not an ML researcher. I build and operate the tools that sit next to the product.

selectedWork.title: QLola / QCash
selectedWork.description: Frontend-heavy work on an enterprise cash-management surface: microfrontend migration with Module Federation, responsive dashboards, payroll transfer and mass transfer workflows with secure file handling.

selectedWork.title: BRI BRILink + BRiSpot/BNS
selectedWork.description: BRILink (Apr 2026–present): Go backend for NPSO catalog and cart on a live banking ecommerce surface. Before that, BRiSpot/BNS (Jan–Mar 2026): protobuf contracts, Kafka event paths, and CISO-facing integration changes across the BNS ecosystem.

selectedWork.title: Kreditplus
selectedWork.description: Finance backend at SIGMATECH / Kreditplus, July 2025 to January 2026 — not a 2026 job. Database migration toward PostgreSQL, backward-compatible APIs, observability, and test coverage on account and transaction flows.

selectedWork.title: Local operator tooling
selectedWork.description: The public slice is silenthand-cua: an unofficial Computer Use host for a local Mac — click, type, and read AX trees without stealing focus. Around it: MCP hosts, persistent context across machines, and the agent loop I actually work in. Not an ML research claim.

selectedWork.title: Momena (Pinturakik)
selectedWork.description: BLE presence-native social product, currently in validation — not shipped, and not an AI automation platform. Go kit + proto + Android BLE scaffold.

philosophy.sectionTitle: The best systems stop asking for attention.
philosophy.body: I care less about flashy software and more about systems that become trustworthy, calm, and almost invisible. The best technology does not demand constant attention. It carries complexity quietly.

contact.cta: If you need complete product delivery across web, backend, or mobile — with an operator stack that does not replace the engineer — I am interested in problems where one person with the right tools can replace a team.
